knowledge.title: OPPORTUNITY_CORE reference lookups
Reference Implementation
knowledge.content:
## Reference Implementation

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `models/silver/opportunity/boe/gws_boe_opportunity_core.sql` | Reference ephemeral staging model (BOE source) |
| `models/silver/opportunity/opportunity_core.sql` | Hub model with SCD1 merge + HIST |
| `models/silver/opportunity/opportunity_reference.yml` | Shared reference source declarations |
| `models/bronze/opportunity_boe_source.yml` | Reference bronze source YAML |
| `macros/opportunity_utils.sql` | HKEY + source system SKEY macros |
| `macros/source_filter_utils.sql` | `set_watermark_var`, `update_watermark_hook`, `m_insert_history`, `m_is_source_active` |
| `macros/lightbox_utils.sql` | `generate_sha2_hash_key` (shared utility) |

knowledge.title: OPPORTUNITY minimum mapping
knowledge.content: A source must map at least: `source_unique_id`; `opportunity_name`; `stage_name` (drives `ref_opportunity_status`, `ref_opportunity_segment`)
